title: The Trial of the Empty Purse | Blackwood Money Tales
description: Drakon drags young Milo before Elder Dev for an unpaid debt, demanding his family meadow. But Ragnar reveals a secret habit that turns the trial upside down: paying yourself first.
recap: Milo was dragged before Elder Dev by Drakon for an unpaid debt, but proved he saved twenty coins out of every hundred first.
cliffhanger: Tomorrow, beware Chintu the fox and his cunning coin-doubling trap in the clearing!
disclaimer: This story is for education only. It is not financial or investment advice.
credits: 3D models: Quaternius (CC0). Voice: Google Gemini text-to-speech. Story and images are AI generated.

cast.name: Drakon
cast.role: black wolf, cruel moneylender who runs the Fang Lending Den

cast.name: Milo
cast.role: brave young deer, the hero; loves his missing mother; learns to save

cast.name: Elder Dev
cast.role: old stag who guards the forest Savings Tree

cast.name: Ragnar
cast.role: grey wolf, last guardian of the forest, wise and gruff mentor

cast.name: Chintu
cast.role: smooth-talking fox who sells get-rich-quick tricks

shots.title: Drakon's Accusation
shots.narration: "Guilty!" snarled Drakon. "Pay fifty coins tonight, Milo, or forfeit your family meadow forever!"
shots.visual: Drakon stands atop a boulder in the trial clearing, snarling fiercely down at Milo.

shots.title: The Forest Court
shots.narration: Elder Dev slammed his staff. The clearing fell silent as Milo stood trembling under trial.
shots.visual: Elder Dev stands majestic under the ancient oak tree, holding court in front of the quiet jungle.

shots.title: The Claim
shots.narration: Drakon snarled, "Milo earned one hundred coins harvesting berries, yet he claims he has nothing left!"
shots.visual: Drakon steps off the rock, sneering aggressively toward the elder stag.

shots.title: Milo's Regret
shots.narration: Milo hung his head. He had bought grain and tools, watching coins slip away instantly.
shots.visual: A close view of Milo bowing his head in deep shame.

shots.title: Drakon Demands Surrender
shots.narration: "He spent everything foolishly!" Drakon barked. "Seize him for the Fang Lending Den by sundown!"
shots.visual: Drakon barks his ultimatum with cruel satisfaction.

shots.title: Guardian Steps In
shots.narration: Ragnar walked calmly into the clearing. "Wait, Elder Dev. Check the forest Savings Tree first."
shots.visual: Ragnar walks firmly into the clearing, catching everyone's attention.

shots.title: Drakon's Mockery
shots.narration: Drakon mocked him. "Youngsters spend first! No reckless deer saves coins when his belly is empty."
shots.visual: Drakon scoffs openly at Ragnar's suggestion.

shots.title: The Threat
shots.narration: Drakon stepped closer, baring cruel fangs. "If he has no savings, he belongs to me!"
shots.visual: Drakon prowls toward Milo, baring his teeth aggressively.

shots.title: Elder Dev Questions Milo
shots.narration: Elder Dev asked sternly, "Milo, did you spend every coin before setting any aside?"
shots.visual: Elder Dev fixes his wise gaze down upon the young deer.

shots.title: Temptations of the Market
shots.narration: Milo looked at the crowd. Market stalls had tempted him with sweet sap every single day.
shots.visual: Milo looks out toward the edge of the clearing, remembering past temptations.

shots.title: Milo's Confession
shots.narration: "I almost did," Milo whispered. "Until Ragnar taught me the golden rule of wealth."
shots.visual: Milo raises his head, finding courage as he looks toward Ragnar.

shots.title: The Golden Rule
shots.narration: Ragnar spoke clearly. "Never save what remains after spending. Always pay yourself first before spending."
shots.visual: Ragnar speaks with quiet authority, commanding the entire clearing.

shots.title: The Secret Formula
shots.narration: "From every hundred coins earned, Milo locked twenty away before buying even one berry," said Ragnar.
shots.visual: Ragnar gestures toward Elder Dev's ancient oak tree.

shots.title: The Hollow Tree Opens
shots.narration: Elder Dev tapped the hollow trunk. Out rolled a gleaming jar of sixty acorn coins!
shots.visual: Elder Dev taps his staff against the tree bark, revealing a hidden hollow.

shots.title: Drakon's Disbelief
shots.narration: Drakon jumped back in shock. "Sixty coins? But you were supposed to be broke!"
shots.visual: Drakon recoils in pure shock, his jaw hanging open.

shots.title: The Verdict
shots.narration: Elder Dev handed Drakon fifty coins. "Debt cleared in full. Ten coins remain Milo's own!"
shots.visual: Elder Dev passes the required coins to Drakon under the golden sky.

shots.title: Defeated Wolf
shots.narration: Drakon snarled in defeat and ran into the dark forest, his trap ruined.
shots.visual: Drakon snarls and flees into the darkening tree line.

shots.title: First True Wealth
shots.narration: Milo celebrated beside Ragnar. For the first time, he held true savings of his own.
shots.visual: Milo stands proud alongside Ragnar in the warm sunset light.

shots.title: The Golden Takeaway
shots.narration: Remember: earn 100, save 20 first, spend 80. Tomorrow, beware Chintu the fox's doubling scam!
shots.visual: Ragnar looks directly toward the viewer from the forest clearing.

shots.title: Subscribe and Disclaimer
shots.narration: Subscribe for Episode 3! This story is for education only, not financial or investment advice.
shots.visual: Milo gives a grateful nod in the calm forest morning.
